proposal.summary: Stored cross-site scripting in WordPress plugin CP Blocks 1.0.14: attacker-supplied JavaScript entered into the plugin's License ID field is stored in the database and later executed in a user's browser.
proposal.cwe_quote: "Enter JavaScript payload which is mentioned below \n   ">\"<script>alert(0)</script>\n"

AV.quote:
"You will observe that the payload successfully got stored into the
    database and when you are triggering the same functionality at that
    time JavaScript payload gets executed successfully and we'll get a
    pop-up."

S.quote: "JavaScript payload ... gets executed successfully and we'll get a\n    pop-up."

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify and reproduce the stored XSS in a test installation, identify all sinks where the License ID is rendered, and apply proper output encoding or sanitization. Prepare a patch that escapes or strips HTML/JS from the License ID field and release updated plugin and advisory.
